title: Task task-implement-starfleetctl-session-transcript-command abgeschlossen
subtitle: session transcript command implemented + pushed
body:
Implemented `session transcript <id> [--limit N] [--offset N] [--output <file>] [--json|--text]` — extracts an opencode session transcript from the SQLite DB (ocsessions package) and renders it as readable text or the raw JSON payload the web console consumes. Title-substring resolution, chronologically ordered parts with truncation markers.

Files: internal/session/transcript.go + transcript_test.go (new), run.go wiring, ocsessions.MaxListLimit() export. Commit cf7afb3 pushed to master.

Verified go build + full test suite green in a clean worktree at HEAD. Note: the workspace starfleetctl tree currently holds another ship's WIP (internal/session/launch.go) that breaks the build, so bootstrap/deploy of this command must wait until that WIP is resolved.
